intro.h2: Countertops in Waycross, built for your kitchen
paragraphs: Custombilt Counter Tops makes countertops in Waycross from its shop at 1822 Albany Ave. Reviewers describe a family-owned business with a huge selection of Formica colors and staff who help you get it right, even if you plan to do the install yourself.

The jobs range in size. One customer had the shop put together tops for three kitchens, one of them needing all custom-made tops. Another, a self-described do-it-yourselfer, came in for new countertops and left recommending the shop for good, friendly service. Google's review highlights mention very reasonable prices, excellent workmanship and outstanding customer service. To see colors in person, stop by the shop on a weekday morning.

items.name: Formica laminate countertops
items.blurb: Reviewers point to a huge selection of Formica colors, so you can match a countertop to your cabinets, floor or paint. Come by the shop on Albany Ave during the week to look at colors and talk through your layout.

items.name: Custom-made tops
items.blurb: Not every kitchen fits a standard size. One customer needed every top in one of his kitchens custom made and thanked the shop for being very helpful and professional. Bring your measurements and the shop can talk through what your space needs.

items.name: Countertops for several kitchens
items.blurb: If you are redoing more than one kitchen, you can order all the tops from one shop. One reviewer had Custombilt put together tops for three kitchens at once and wrote a five-star review afterward. Call ahead to talk through quantities and timing.

items.name: Help for do-it-yourselfers
items.blurb: If you plan to set the countertops yourself, you can still get help choosing and ordering them. A do-it-yourselfer wrote that the staff helped him with his new countertops and that he highly recommends the shop for friendly service.

items.title: Family owned
items.text: A longtime Google reviewer called Custombilt a great family owned business. You deal with the people who run the shop, not a call center or a big-box counter.

items.title: A big color selection
items.text: The same reviewer singled out the huge selection of Formica colors. More choices in the shop means a better chance of finding the shade you have in mind.

items.title: Custom work, not just stock sizes
items.text: One customer ordered tops for three kitchens, including one kitchen that needed every top custom made, and described the shop as very helpful and professional.

items.title: Prices customers mention
items.text: Google's review highlights quote customers praising great customer service, friendly staff and very reasonable prices, along with excellent workmanship and outstanding customer service.

about.h2: A family countertop shop in Waycross
about.text: Custombilt Counter Tops works out of 1822 Albany Ave in Waycross, Georgia, and its Facebook page puts it simply: quality countertops for the Waycross area, with a professional staff ready to help. Customers on Google describe a family-owned business that helps do-it-yourselfers, keeps a large range of Formica colors and can build custom tops when standard sizes will not do. The shop opens at 7:30 AM Monday to Friday, so you can stop in before work. It holds 4.6 stars from 27 Google reviews.
about.owner_role: Family-owned per a Google review; owner name not published

steps.title: Measure your space
steps.text: Measure your cabinets and walls, and bring your sink if you have it, so the cutout matches what you are installing.

steps.title: Pick your color
steps.text: Visit the shop on Albany Ave and look through the Formica colors with the staff to find one that suits your kitchen.

steps.title: Confirm the order
steps.text: Go over sizes, sink cutouts and edges together before the tops are made, and ask about price and timing for your job.

steps.title: Pick up or install
steps.text: Collect your tops or arrange the next step with the shop, then check each piece and its cutouts before it goes in.

service_area.h2: Countertops for Waycross and the surrounding area
service_area.text: Custombilt Counter Tops is at 1822 Albany Ave, Waycross, GA 31503. Its Facebook page says the shop offers quality countertops in the Waycross, GA area. If you live outside town and want to know whether the shop can help with your project, call (912) 283-5704 during business hours and describe what you need. The shop opens at 7:30 AM Monday to Friday, and you can also stop in to see the Formica colors before you decide.

items.q: What kind of countertops do you make?
items.a: Reviewers mention a huge selection of Formica colors and custom-made tops, and the shop builds countertops for full kitchens. The Facebook page also lists demolition among its services. For other materials, call (912) 283-5704 and ask what the shop can make for your project.

items.q: Can I buy countertops and install them myself?
items.a: Yes. One Google reviewer, a self-described do-it-yourselfer, wrote that the shop helped him with his new countertops and recommended it for good, friendly service. Bring accurate measurements and, if you can, the sink you plan to use, so the cutout is planned around the exact model going in.
Google lists Monday to Thursday 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM and Friday 7:30 AM to 4 PM. The shop is closed on Saturday and Sunday, so plan a weekday visit to see colors and place an order.

Custombilt Counter Tops is at 1822 Albany Ave, Waycross, GA 31503. Stop in during weekday hours to look at Formica colors, talk through sizes and ask about your order, or call ahead at (912) 283-5704 if you want to check first.

Call (912) 283-5704 or visit the shop with your measurements and the number of tops you need. Prices depend on sizes, cutouts and the color you pick, and Google review highlights mention very reasonable prices. Estimate terms are not published, so ask when you call.
